episodes.title: Nothing in This World Is Easy
episodes.summary: On the night of her 36th birthday, Nadia meets an untimely end ... then suddenly finds herself back at the party her friends threw for her.

episodes.title: The Great Escape
episodes.summary: Confused and hung over, Nadia tries to piece together what happened the night before. She tracks down Wardog, the drug dealer with the Israeli joints.

episodes.title: A Warm Body
episodes.summary: Nadia's hunt for clues leads her to a Yeshiva school -- but she needs John's help. Out searching for Oatmeal, Nadia befriends a homeless man.

episodes.title: Alan's Routine
episodes.summary: Meticulous as always, Alan steadies himself for a rendez-vous with his girlfriend. Meanwhile, Nadia's latest discovery sends her reeling.

episodes.title: Superiority Complex
episodes.summary: Perturbed by the changes in his routine, Alan shows up at Nadia's birthday party. Nadia tries to make amends to John, and Alan confronts Mike.

episodes.title: Reflection
episodes.summary: Nadia and Alan try to figure out how they're connected. Alan can't remember his first death, so Nadia follows him over the course of his night.

episodes.title: The Way Out
episodes.summary: As the present begins to unravel, Nadia's troubled past comes back to haunt her, and Alan worries they're running out of time.

episodes.title: Ariadne
episodes.summary: Nadia and Alan look for each other and finally cross paths at the deli. Something's not right -- but they're not giving up on each other.

episodes.title: Nowhen
episodes.summary: Nadia's 40th birthday is a few days away, and she's planning to celebrate it quietly with Alan. Then something really strange happens.

episodes.title: Coney Island Baby
episodes.summary: While hopping around the city searching for the missing Krugerrands, Nadia runs into a familiar face who lends her a hand.

episodes.title: Brain Drain
episodes.summary: Nadia learns an intriguing fact about the family fortune that sends her on a quest for clues — and her situation takes a bizarre new turn.

episodes.title: Station to Station
episodes.summary: Alan gets in touch with his roots in Berlin. On a trip to Budapest, Nadia and Maxine wind up at a mind-bending house party.

episodes.title: Exquisite Corpse
episodes.summary: Nadia tracks down the stolen valuables and formulates a plan to secure her family's future. But she comes to a grim realization.

episodes.title: Schrödinger's Ruth
episodes.summary: After the weirdest subway ride yet, Nadia navigates a puzzling predicament. Meanwhile, Alan desperately tries to find Nadia.

episodes.title: Matryoshka
episodes.summary: On Nadia's birthday, she and Alan reunite in a familiar place. But they clash over how to handle the future (and the past).
